description: Paint part of the house or a thing: door, siding, trim, roof, shutters, fence, mailbox, a room's walls (kitchen, living), or a thing (sofa). Colours are words as you'd say them (moss, rust, dusty rose, deep teal) or a #hex; a room can take a material (plaster, zellige).

colour.description: The colour (or a material for a room).

what.description: What to paint: door, siding, trim, roof, fence, a room, a thing.

name: paint
title: Paint
